events.content: Audrey: Hey Andrew! Good to see ya! What's been up since we last talked?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Hey Audrey! So, I started a new job as a Financial Analyst last week - it's been quite a change from my previous job. How about you? Anything interesting happening?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Congrats on the new job! So I got these new collars and tags for my dogs - so cute!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Thanks! That sounds cute. Can I see a picture?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of two dogs are standing in the grass with their mouths open] Sure! See them with their new collars, cute right?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Cute little guys! What are their names and how long have you had them?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: I've had them for 3 years! Their names are Pepper, Precious and Panda. I can't live without my little ones!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: That's awesome! Have you always wanted a dog, even with living in the city? Can they still go on adventures?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Absolutely! They're city dogs and we explore all the time. They love trying out new parks and trails. We go on adventures together very often.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Wow, sounds like they make life so awesome! Kinda jealous of all those fun outings with them.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: They really do! It's great how much happiness they bring. Do you have any pets?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: No, no pets right now. But I do love animals.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: That's great to hear! Animals are truly amazing. Do you have a favorite animal?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: I've always been awed by birds. Their power to soar and explore new spots is amazing.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Yeah, birds are amazing! I can imagine it feels incredible to soar and see the world from up high. Do you have a favorite type of bird?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: [Image: a photo of two birds flying in the sky with a sun shining behind them] Eagles have always mesmerized me; they're so strong and graceful!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Yeah they're beautiful. Do you go bird-watching? It must be awesome to see them up close.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Haven't specifically gone out for bird-watching, but I do spot them when I hike.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Nice, spotting pretty birds while hiking must be great. Do you have any favorite hiking spots?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Fox Hollow is a great trail to hike on weekends; the views are awesome!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Cool, gonna give it a try. Thanks for the suggestion!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: No problem! Let me know how you like it. Have fun hiking!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Thanks! I'll let you know. Have a good one!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Take care and have a good one! See ya!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photo of a small white dog sitting on a carpet] Hey Andrew, I got a surprise for you! We adopted another puppy called Pixie. She's SO cute! Isn't she just the cutest?
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: That's awesome! Pixie is so cute! Did you ever check out that hiking spot we talked about last time?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Thanks! I know right? She's so cute! Pixie's been keeping us busy, so I haven't had a chance to check out that hiking spot yet.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Yeah, I get it. A puppy really takes some work. Has she settled in okay? Is she getting along with the other pups?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of a dog playing with a group of other dogs] Pixie's fitting in great! It took her a few days to get used to the other dogs, but now they're awesome friends. They love playing and exploring the house - so cute!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: That's awesome! Is Pepper adjusting well to her?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of two dogs standing in the grass near a fence] Pepper took a bit to get used to her, but now they're always together!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: That's great to hear! I'm considering getting a dog too, but it can be challenging finding a dog-friendly place in the city. Do you have any tips on finding such a place?
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of a dog sitting in a field of flowers] We used websites that helped us find a place that allowed dogs. They had filters that made it super easy. Found a perfect spot thanks to them!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Wow, that's so cool! I'll give those websites a try, thanks for the info!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: You got it! I hope you find a great spot soon!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Thanks! Fingers crossed for the apartment and that furry friend.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: I'm keeping my fingers crossed for you to find a great furry friend and an apartment.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Hope I find one soon. Can't wait!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: You'll love them! They're great for cuddles and companionship.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: [Image: a photo of a dog sitting on a couch in a living room] It'd be so great to have a furry buddy to cuddle and hang with. Here's a photo of my family's dog on a couch.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: [Image: a photography of a dog laying on a couch with a pillow] Our furry friends make great cuddle buddies. Here's one of them enjoying some lazy couch time!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: [Image: a photo of a man walking a dog on a trail] That pic is so cute! It would be fun to hang out with a dog, cuddling away. Got me thinking of my old hiking pics and how much I miss exploring nature trails with my family's dog. Ah, the peaceful moments out in nature!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Taking them on hikes must be awesome! That makes me want to hike with my dogs.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: [Image: a photography of a man sitting on a rock with a dog] Hiking with a dog is way fun, it's a great way to bond and create memories together.
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Yeah! Exploring nature with them and making memories is awesome!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Definitely! I miss those moments. I need to find a dog-friendly spot soon so I can get exploring again!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: Yep! I hope you find the perfect dog-friendly spot soon so you can make new memories with them.
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: Thanks! I'll keep looking until I find it. Super excited for what's next!
events.speaker: Andrew

events.content: Audrey: So excited for you! I can't wait to see where you and your furry friend decide to hang out. All the best!
events.speaker: Audrey

events.content: Andrew: I'll keep you posted. Ttyl, Bye!
events.speaker: Andrew
